claim: Genuine Ext-defined H1(Spec R,O)=0 for every commutative domain R, via actual principal-open cocycle splitting and original sheaf gluing; vanishing on both exact original affine charts of the completed source.

obligations.name: Original affine geometry and coefficient sheaf
obligations.required: Retain actual Spec structure sheaf, its original sections, restrictions and additive sheaf.
obligations.constructed: ActualPrincipalSections318 uses (Spec.structureSheaf R).obj on actual basic opens; AffineStructureSectionLifting318.O forgets only ring multiplication.
obligations.justification: sections_eq_original and O_eq_original are definitional equalities with the existing original scheme carriers. The final theorem is stated on the unchanged structureH carrier. No substitute Cech group is called H1.

obligations.name: Domain and principal localization
obligations.required: Bind every algebraic fraction calculation to the actual principal-open section localization.
obligations.constructed: PrincipalFractionClearing318.away is the original Localization.subalgebra.ofField at powers of a nonzero element. ActualPrincipalSections318.embed is the actual localization map to FractionRing R.
obligations.justification: mem_away_iff proves the denominator presentation. Actual section localization gives injectivity and exact image equal to away; embed_restrict binds original restriction maps. Domain and nonzero hypotheses are explicit, not silently dropped.

obligations.name: Finite denominator contraction
obligations.required: An arbitrary finite principal-cover additive cocycle must split by regular local sections.
obligations.constructed: clear_finite chooses one exponent clearing every second denominator. power_coefficients derives a sum a_j f_j^N=1 from the actual cover.
obligations.justification: Define b_i as sum a_j f_j^N c_ij. The actual localization subalgebra proves regularity; the cocycle equation proves c_ij=b_i-b_j with the chosen sign. The unit-ideal cover follows from the original basic-open cover theorem, not a new assumption.

obligations.name: Actual overlaps and full cocycle equation
obligations.required: Transport the algebraic contraction back to actual pair/triple overlap sections.
obligations.constructed: ActualPrincipalCocycle318.Cocycle uses actual restricted sections on D((f_i f_j) f_k).
obligations.justification: The fraction embeddings commute with restrictions and are injective. split therefore returns original local sections whose actual restrictions have the prescribed difference. Triple and pair opens remain the original ones; the all-indices cocycle equation includes diagonal cases.

obligations.name: Finite local lifts from an actual sheaf epimorphism
obligations.required: Obtain a finite principal cover with lifts of a given global quotient section without assuming pointwise epimorphy.
obligations.constructed: AffinePrincipalLocalLifts318.data uses the actual locally-surjective characterization of epimorphisms, refines each local neighborhood to a basic open, and uses compactness of Spec.
obligations.justification: Each chosen principal element is nonzero because its open contains the chosen point. The resulting finite index, cover equality and lift images are stored in Data. Empty-index behavior is governed by the actual cover equality; no nonempty-index or omitted-point assumption is introduced.

obligations.name: Arbitrary additive-sheaf extension and original gluing
obligations.required: Prove global lifting with original O kernel even if the middle and quotient sheaves are not quasi-coherent.
obligations.constructed: AffineStructureSectionLifting318.surjective takes an actual short exact sequence O to F to G.
obligations.justification: Sectionwise left exactness gives unique kernel sections for pair differences; monicity proves their triple cocycle. Subtracting the constructed local kernel corrections yields compatible sections. Original sheaf gluing yields a global lift; local equality proves its exact image. No extension-closure of QC sheaves or all-sheaves direct-image exactness is assumed.

obligations.name: Genuine Ext-defined degree-one vanishing
obligations.required: Show H1 itself vanishes, rather than only a disconnected Cech calculation.
obligations.constructed: AffineStructureHOne318.eq_zero embeds original O into an actual injective additive sheaf and forms its actual cokernel sequence.
obligations.justification: The original Ext long exact sequence expresses any H1 class as a connecting image of H0 of the cokernel. The proved section-surjectivity lifts that global section; H.equiv0 naturality turns it into a degree-zero lift. Exactness of the connecting class kills the original class. Standard actual HasExt/enough-injectives instances discharge the infrastructure.

obligations.name: Actual original source-cover consumer
obligations.required: Specialize to both exact charts covering the original completed source, including finite branch points and infinity.
obligations.constructed: ActualSourceAffineHOne318 uses the actual SourceOrder c and InfinityOpenChart318.OpenOrder c for every c:Fin4 to Q units.
obligations.justification: Existing original domain theorems discharge both hypotheses. finite_chart_zero uses the full finite chart; infinity_chart_zero uses the unchanged reciprocal infinity neighborhood; cover_chart_zero checks both Bool indices of ContactGlobalSmooth318.cover. No quotient by a removed branch locus or different model is introduced.

obligations.name: Scope and remaining comparison bridge
obligations.required: Separate the newly proved affine O acyclicity from unproved stronger consequences.
obligations.constructed: This packet proves genuine H1 of original O on Spec of a domain is zero and applies it to the two exact original source charts.
obligations.justification: It does not yet prove canonical H1 direct-image comparison surjectivity, transport the affine theorem through every scheme-affine isomorphism, or build the all-affine inverse-image-open epimorphism bridge. It does not prove general QC acyclicity, higher-degree vanishing, H1 dimension/spanning, Picard tangent comparison, Serre duality or Jacobian isogeny. New proof does not assert absence of historical justification.
